description: Psion learning, resource spending, combat and persistence through low/middle/high progression in the real engine on BGEE through the installed campaign XP cap.
prerequisites: Disposable legal fixture with Psion and the read-only checkpoint helper; six legally created discipline actors or their local saves.
Controlled hostile and friendly combat targets, ordinary rest, inn rental and temple healing access, and a second area.
Local XP grants are permitted for preparation; all subsequent level-up, learning, casting and persistence transitions must execute in GemRB.
Expected PP, learning credits, power eligibility, DC resources and progression values are derived independently from current rules and installed resources.
Before preparation, hash and read installed XPCAP and XPLEVEL rows; derive attainable levels from those resources. Controlled XP may reach the installed cap but must not change or bypass it.
instructions: Record before/after learning credits and known powers for confirm and cancel, and compare each discipline's visible eligible powers at each unlocked tier.
Observe PP before and after a legal manifestation, insufficient-PP attempt, target cancellation and legal/over-limit augmentation. Include actual values, not a claimed pass flag.
For DC selection change current Intelligence through a controlled game effect, cast again and record the actual selected resource against its installed INT-specific oracle.
Exercise focus, Center Mind, feats, skills and quickslots through their real UI actions; observe combat effects and resource changes.

Use actual level-up screens at low and middle levels and the maximum level permitted by installed XPCAP/XPLEVEL. Record cap XP and expected/observed level in psion.level.cap. Compare all six disciplines at every campaign-accessible tier; rejected higher tiers belong in psion.tier-restrictions. Level 17+ access is required separately on BG2EE/ToB, not enabled by altering BGEE caps.

Exercise actual inn room selection and rental confirmation for psion.rest.inn; derive restored spell charges and any pool reset from installed rules. Temple healing is a separate store purchase, not rest: record native cure identity/effects, expected HP healing and unchanged known spells and PP in psion.temple-healing. Capture before/after values and native store UI actions; never invoke the store callbacks directly.
Observe ordinary rest, inn rental, area transition and save/reload against recorded baselines or the applicable reset rule. Quit normally.
